Scottish Ensemble: Bach & Blood

Inhale. Exhale. Every breath resonates and each string sings in this performance that brings together Scottish Ensemble and singers from the Chamber Choir of the National Youth Choir of Scotland.

Renowned choreographer Pam Tanowitz reimagines Beethoven's Pastoral through an evocative dance performance, developed in collaboration with composer Caroline Shaw and painter Sarah Crowner.

Euchar Gravina: Once upon a place

Euchar Gravina brings together a programme of contemporary chamber pieces that inhabit, remember or conjure a place of their own, tracing how places are recreated as music reaches for them.
